notes: Implementation caveat: when the PoolManager has insufficient ETH or a direct beneficiary transfer fails, CrownHook mints ERC-6909 ETH claims directly to the beneficiary and counts them in crownPaid. This differs from the brief's immediate wallet payment and skip-the-cut-on-transfer-failure requirement. A failed registry read or failure of both payment paths skips the cut. The hook holds neither fees nor claims; beneficiary claims require separate redemption. Target: Robinhood Chain (4663), CrownToken (Crown Demo / CRWN) paired with native ETH, with a 1.25% LP fee. CrownHook creates its own adminless CrownRegistry in its constructor, so no external registry address or token constructor argument is needed. Its constructor arguments are PoolManager, launch factory and owner, in that order. All hook callbacks require the PoolManager; afterInitialize additionally requires the initialization sender to be the factory or owner. For the launch pool, afterInitialize derives keccak256 of the uppercase CRWN symbol from currency1, records the pool at the default 100 bps hook cut, and crowns that token with $owner as genesis beneficiary. The owner can explicitly configure future pools' ticker and cut from 0 to 500 bps before initialization; live pool settings cannot change. Both swap callbacks and both swap delta permissions are enabled to take the cut from currency0, native ETH, for exact-input and exact-output trades. crownPaid[ticker][currency] includes direct transfers and beneficiary claims. Challenges require an exact 0.01 ETH bond, counted as challenger stake, after a 7-day minimum reign. The staking window is 72 hours followed by a 24-hour timelock. A challenger wins only with strictly more stake and at least 0.05 ETH total stake; its beneficiary is the challenge opener. Failed challenges impose a 3-day cooldown. Winners recover their stake plus half the 20% losing-side slash; losers share the remaining 80%, through pull claims. The other slash half goes to treasury 0xf19f11dee16a341671e6ed3e209b704c1bbc3e57; when the winning side has no stake, the entire slash goes there. Rounding remainders go to each side's last claimer. CrownChallengerToken is the separate same-name, same-symbol candidate provided by script/DeployChallenger.s.sol, not an additional manifest deployment. The repository includes registry/math tests, a local buy-challenge-stake-finalize-buy integration test, and a ticker site with king, fee totals, challenge state and transaction controls. The site awaits actual deployment addresses. No live deployment, live dethrone demo or Sourcify verification is asserted here. README records Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer enabled with 200 runs, viaIR enabled, bytecode_hash none and CBOR metadata enabled. The pool fields retain the launch reference values; the deployer derives the actual opening price from launch policy.
